jobs.description:
For more than three decades, **Design West Technologies Inc.** has served as a trusted partner to the Department of War (DoW), delivering mission-critical design engineering and rugged manufacturing solutions that protect our nation's warfighters. As we enter our next chapter, we are blending our deep-rooted defense heritage with a start-up culture designed to take advantage of the current DoW landscape. Operating out of our facility in Tustin, CA, we are seeking an experienced, forward-thinking **Software Engineer** to help build and improve the internal applications that support our manufacturing operations. This role will play a key part in develop features, troubleshoot issues, and help implement business-critical software. The ideal candidate will bring strong experience building and maintaining web applications, take ownership of new business initiatives, ability to translate business needs into practical solutions, and carry projects through implementation and testing.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

As a Software Engineer, you will work with our primary technology stack, including TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, and SQL, to develop and enhance an internal website that integrates with our ERP system, Sage 100. Your work will focus on extending the ERP's capabilities and developing solutions that support our business needs. Projects may include digitizing paper-based processes, developing interactive reports, building new data-tracking systems, and creating integrations between our website and Sage 100. You will work on applications that support a wide range of business operations, including production, work orders, planning, inventory management, manufacturing quality assurance, and other business workflows.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Build and improve internal web applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript.
* Develop REST APIs and business logic using Node.js and Express.
* Write and troubleshoot SQL queries, investigate data issues, and maintain reliable application behavior.
* Work with internal users and the technical team to turn business needs into practical software improvements.
* Diagnose problems across the user interface, APIs, databases, and integrations.
* Help maintain and gradually modernize existing applications while preserving day-to-day business operations.
* Contribute to Sage 100 integrations, data synchronization, and workflow automation with guidance from the team.
* Validate changes through end-to-end testing, and development environments before release.
* Document changes and support deployment and troubleshooting using established team procedures.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 2+ years of software development experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web technologies.
* Experience building and maintaining web applications
* Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript and React.
* Experience developing backend APIs with Node.js/Express or a comparable framework.
* Solid relational database fundamentals, including SQL queries, joins, and data relationships.
* Familiarity with Git, HTTP, debugging tools, and collaborative code review.
* Ability to read an existing codebase, trace a problem across application layers, and make focused, maintainable changes.
* Clear communication, attention to detail, and willingness to ask questions and incorporate feedback.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS, or shadcn/ui
* Microsoft SQL Server (T-SQL)
* Docker, Kubernetes, general DevOps experience
* Azure
* Python
* Manufacturing software, ERP systems, inventory, or production workflows
* Linux, NGINX, system, or automated testing and deployment workflows

Overview:

Lynker is seeking a highly skilled Software Engineer to support the NOAA/NWS Office of Modeling and Development by managing, developing, and optimizing the meteorological data decoder systems. This role focuses on the critical pipeline that converts diverse, native-format meteorological observations into standardized formats required for downstream numerical weather prediction (NWP) systems.

Responsibilities:

**Duties of the Scientific Software Engineer will include the following:**

**Technical Operations & R&D**

  

* Develop, maintain, and optimize C and Fortran programs used to decode raw meteorological bulletins.

  

* Translate non-standard native data formats into BUFR and JEDI IODA netcdf by engineering specialized decoder logic

  

* Ensure uninterrupted, efficient data flow by managing input and output streams for ingest data queues, descriptor lists, and temporary BUFR message storage.

**Systems & Data Integration**

  

* Monitor and troubleshoot operational data ingestion across major meteorological data servers, including LDM, DBNet, GTS, and WIS2.

  

* Ensure decoded data tanks are optimized for rapid assimilation into the NCEP NWP system, supporting the generation of thousands of daily weather products.

  

* Manage and maintain the software repositories pertaining to legacy and operational decoder processing.

**Coordination & Reporting**

  

* Liaise with upstream data originators and downstream NCO Operations users to seamlessly integrate new observational data types into the BUFR pipeline.

  

* Report on software task progress, system performance metrics, and project risks to the Lead Scientist and Federal oversight managers.

  

* Participate in the Modernization of Observation Infrastructure project (GEODE) to transition legacy decoder frameworks to modern architectures.

Qualifications:

**The Scientist Software Engineer selected for this role should meet the following qualifications:**

  

* Advanced skills and knowledge of Fortran and C programming languages specifically tailored for data parsing and processing.

  

* Deep understanding of **BUFR** (Binary Universal Form for the Representation of meteorological data), including table-driven descriptors and binary extraction logic.

  

* Experience working in a UNIX/Linux environment with advanced shell scripting languages.

  

* Demonstrated knowledge of meteorological data servers and distribution networks (LDM, DBNet, GTS, WIS2).

  

* Skills and knowledge of High-Performance Computing (HPC) file systems and job schedulers (e.g., WCOSS environment, MPI, Slurm, LSF).

  

* Knowledge of modern software development practices and version control software, particularly Git/GitHub/Gitflow.

  

* Ability to perform complex, mission-critical debugging in a fast-paced, operational environment.

**Additional desirable experiences and skills include:**

  

* Knowledge of global Data Assimilation (DA) systems and observation networks.
* Experience transitioning legacy meteorological codebases into Cloud environments.
* Background in atmospheric physics or earth system modeling.

Lynker is a growing, employee owned business, specializing in professional, scientific and technical services. Our continually expanding team combines scientific expertise with mature, results-driven processes and tools to achieve technically sound, cost effective solutions in hydrology/water sciences, geospatial analysis, information technology, resource management, conservation, and management and business process improvement.
